bull_bear.body:
- As on 30th June 2026 (Standalone) the deck states Capital Employed of Rs. 105,910 crore, Net Worth of Rs. 70,658 crore and LT Loan Outstanding of Rs. 13,823 crore.
- Debt Equity Ratio is shown rising across the series: 0.22 (FY23), 0.29 (FY24), 0.26 (FY25), 0.28 (FY26) and 0.32 (Q1 FY27).
- Equity of Rs. 77,593 crore comprises Equity Share Capital of Rs. 6,575 crore and Other Equity of Rs. 71,018 crore, within which Retained Earnings are Rs. 63,956 crore.
- A footnote records that "Share Price & EPS for past periods are adjusted for Bonus issue & Buy Back", indicating both have occurred, though the deck gives no dates or amounts.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- The deck identifies GAIL (India) Limited as "A Government of India Undertaking - A Maharatna Company", presenting under the tagline "Energizing Possibilities".
- The deck frames the business around four physical performance lines - Natural Gas Transmission, Natural Gas Marketing, LPG Transmission, and Petrochemical / Liquid Hydrocarbons sales - reported on a standalone basis, alongside a separate consolidated set.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Disclosure basis] The deck is the Investors' & Analysts' Presentation for Q1 FY 2026-27, filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 and dated 31.07.2026.
- [Standalone vs consolidated] The deck reports both standalone and consolidated sets; the balance sheet, physical performance and key ratios are standalone only, so group-level asset and leverage detail is not disclosed.

deepdive.thesis: GAIL (India) Ltd is India's state-owned leader in natural gas transmission and marketing, driving the nation's energy transition through expanded infrastructure, petrochemicals, and pioneering green hydrogen and biogas initiatives.
